latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Generative — generate and edit videos automatically with AI.

- Upload video or audio files up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, etc.) for generative AI video editing.
- Describe your desired edits (auto-cut pauses, add B-roll, generate intros) and receive an AI-edited video in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup with free token generation for anonymous users.
- Handles credits, session management, and error cases (e.g., expired tokens, file limits).
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, and iterative workflows; status updates guide users throughout processing.
